author: Kenji Tanaka — Stair-Climbing Locomotion
purpose: locked cluster holding torque and disc clamp on steep stair
code_or_query:
import math
Wpar=60*9.81
Wtot=66.5*9.81
riser=0.197; tread=0.254
theta=math.atan2(riser,tread)
slope=Wtot*math.sin(theta)
# cluster pivot torque: load on axle moment about contact, arm ~ cluster radius 0.185 m
Rclus=0.185
Ttot=Wtot*math.sin(theta)*Rclus*0.9  # 0.9 accounts tilt geometry
Tperside=Ttot/2
print(f"Wtot={Wtot:.1f} N theta={math.degrees(theta):.1f} deg slope={slope:.1f} N Ttot={Ttot:.1f} Nm Tperside={Tperside:.1f} Nm")
# disc: 160mm rotor mean radius 0.068 m, mu 0.35, two pads T=2*mu*F*r
for D,r in [("120mm",0.05),("160mm",0.068)]:
    F=Ttot/(2*0.35*r)
    print(D, f"Fclamp={F:.0f} N")
# hand force at 1.1m handle to hold Ttot without brake
Fhand=Ttot/1.1
print(f"Fhand_no_brake={Fhand:.0f} N")
# descent power at 0.2 m/s along slope
P=slope*0.2
print(f"P_descent_0p2mps={P:.0f} W, energy per riser={60*9.81*0.197:.0f} J")
